evidence.basis: The C300 product page explicitly describes fast KTS printing with C300 and defines C300 as Couche 300gsm. It does not specify this product's dimensions, printed sides or lamination.

The standard-card page identifies 90×54mm as a common size and says custom sizes are available. It lists one/two sides and finishing options generally, without locking those to the digital or offset price tables.

informationResponseExample: Kích thước danh thiếp thông dụng là 90 × 54 mm. Khổ khác cần xác nhận quy cách.
integrationRule: Answer product-information questions separately from price requests. A common reference size is not the selected customer size and must not modify a retained quote, quantity, method or price/specification slots. Offset-specific price-recipe questions remain unresolved unless separately confirmed.
sourceTimingRule: Source pages contain varying production claims. This informational supplement captures none of them and authorizes no deadline promise.
